about: The Workbench icons of the TecnoballZ drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is Debian's tecnoballz.xpm (GPL 3 or later, like the game). TecnoballZ-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, TecnoballZ.info beside the program. ReadMe.info is also copied for the licence; Folder.info for data.
